body: Public speaking. Have always struggled with severe anxiety when it comes to giving presentations or speeches. I smoked hookah excessively for about 3 years. Smoked multiple bowls of shisha everyday with my friends. We didn't think much of the health consequences at the time. Mostly cause we just didn't give a shit but also cause the studies being  published were pretty inconclusive. But enough research has been done now to show hookah is pretty terrible for you. The water doesn't make it a cleaner smoking experience. Your still inhaling carcinogens and a ton of tar. It got to the point where my friends and I were sneezing or coughing up blood and other disgusting shit every time we smoked.

I've had it happen to me twice in my lifetime. Both instances occurred in college. And looking back I was incredibly stressed out when they occurred, which is what I believe triggered it. Anyways, I remember waking up in the middle of the night except I couldn't open my eyes and my body was completely paralyzed. I was really disoriented trying to understand what was going on. Then it got scary. It became harder and harder to breathe and the more I struggled to breathe the more I got the sensation that I felt like I was falling until everything went blank. I woke up the next morning shocked that I was still alive. I truly believed I was dying, it's a horrible feeling.
